title: wildmat: no fast path for trivial * pattern
description: matches_wildmat runs the full O(n*m) DP and allocates a 2D Vec even when the pattern is literally '*', which should immediately return true. This matters in list_active and list_newsgroups (reader/src/session/commands/list.rs): a client sending 'LIST ACTIVE *' (extremely common) causes one full DP allocation per group in the server's group list. On a full Usenet feed with 100,000 groups, that is 100,000 avoidable DP runs per LIST command. Fix: in wildmat_match, add a leading check -- if pattern == b"*" return true immediately. Optionally extend to leading/trailing star normalization. This is a single-line guard at the top of wildmat_match that eliminates all allocation for the most common LIST pattern.
